verdict.line: You lose if Tahm chains three Q stacks into a stun-Devour solo kill around level 6-8; you win from the midgame onward once Heartsteel/Warmog's bulk outpaces his percent-health damage, which is why the head-to-head sits at 52.3% over 153 games even though he owns the lane and solo-kill stats.

brief.thesis: Tahm Kench's entire kill threat is Q (Tongue Lash) stacking An Acquired Taste to three, stunning you, then cashing it in with R (Devour) — a combo that doesn't exist until he hits level 6 and unlocks Devour. Outside of that window, and whenever his Q is on cooldown, your only job is denying stacks and soaking the poke with sustain. Mundo's passive (Adrenaline Rush) and an HP-stacking build eventually out-grow Tahm's passive, which scales off his own total health rather than yours, so the lane flips in your favor once items come online.

theirWindow.what: He's one landed Q away from a free stun into Devour that can solo-kill you under tower. Back off to half-screen or let the Q catch a minion instead of you until his stacks reset.

yourWindow.when: Right after his Q lands or misses
yourWindow.what: Tongue Lash is down for 5-7 seconds depending on rank, and he has no other poke or escape tool in that window. Walk up and chain autos with W (Burning Agony) since it only costs you health you're already regenerating back.

powerCurve.note: Q poke harasses freely, no kill threat yet
Q cooldown shrinks, stacks build faster
Devour live, stun combo can solo-kill
Warmog's/Spirit Visage bulk outscales his percent-health hits

start.why: The flat damage reduction and extra regen directly answer Tahm's Q poke and auto harass, which is the only damage he has before level 6.

boots.why: You have zero gap close or peel, so the flat move speed is what lets you disengage before a stun-Devour combo lands or close distance once his Q is down.

core.why: Converts the damage you tank from his poke into permanent bonus HP, which is exactly the resource that wins this matchup by midgame.
Massive HP pool plus the regen passive makes trading into Tahm's percent-health passive damage a losing proposition for him.
His kit is entirely magic damage, so the magic resist plus the healing amp on your passive and Grasp sustain compound hard.

situational.when: you need an early AoE waveclear spike to punish his weaker clear before your core items finish
the game is turning into a split-push race and you want wave clear and siege damage over pure bulk
their jungler or another laner builds heavy sustained auto-attack damage onto you later in the game

runes.keystoneWhy: Heals you and grows permanent bonus HP on proc, directly countering his Q poke and feeding the same stacking-health gameplan as Heartsteel.

summoners.why: Teleport lets you reset and scale through the dangerous 6-8 all-in window instead of forcing a fight, and Ghost is your only way to disengage or stick to him since you have no dash.

playing.title: Never be the third stack
playing.detail: Track his Acquired Taste count on your buff bar and disengage at two stacks rather than risk eating a free stun into Devour.

playing.title: Trade only after his Q is down
playing.detail: His Tongue Lash is 5-7 seconds depending on rank with no other poke tool, so that's your window to walk in and chain autos plus W (Burning Agony).

playing.title: Respect Abyssal Dive from level 6
playing.detail: He can dive onto you from 1000 range for damage and a knockup, so don't overextend near brush once his W is ranked.

playing.title: Don't fear low HP alone
playing.detail: E (Masochism) scales your AD off missing health, so trading while low is fine as long as his stun-Devour combo isn't actually up.

playing.title: Deny his stacking on minions
playing.detail: His clear is weaker than yours, so slow-push or freeze to limit the number of times he can throw Q into the wave to pad stacks for free.

playing.title: Play for the midgame, not skirmishes
playing.detail: The 52.3% win rate comes from outscaling him, not out-trading him early, so avoid forcing all-ins before your Heartsteel stacks and Warmog's are online.

brief.patchCaveat: Builds, runes, summoners, and all win-rate/pick-rate numbers are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and timing calls are my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid being hit with his (Q)! Avoid his third stack to avoid being swallowed. Use [Q] to slow him down to prevent him from gaining stacks.
